source_name: Financial and Economic Snapshot - Foreign Exchange Market
measure: KRW exchange rates against major currencies; KRW/USD and KRW/CNY interbank closing rates; KRW/JPY reference time series; effective exchange-rate indices
unit: KRW per foreign-currency unit or index
methodology: BOK notes KRW/USD and KRW/CNY are based on Seoul foreign-exchange-market interbank closing rates; KRW/JPY uses Hana Bank quoted rate with a timing break before/after 2016-07-29; nominal/real effective exchange-rate indices use BIS broad index where indicated
limitations: Dashboard contains multiple series with different source/method definitions. Do not merge daily spot/reference rates with BIS effective exchange-rate indices. Preserve the 2016-07-29 KRW/JPY timing-method break. Exact underlying ECOS table/item codes should be retrieved from ECOS metadata before automated ingestion.

source_name: ECOS exchange-rate source referenced by BOK Snapshot
methodology: ECOS is the statistical source named by the Bank of Korea Snapshot for major-currency KRW exchange-rate charts
limitations: API key/metadata lookup may be required for bulk automated extraction. Table code and item code are intentionally left UNKNOWN until verified directly from ECOS metadata; do not infer codes from third-party mirrors.
